entities.name: Query beta-ketoacyl synthase III
observations: 323 aa cytosolic enzyme sequence; exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Brucella abortus FabH/KAS III proteins.
Pfam domains: Thiolase_N (PF00108), ACP_syn_III (PF08545), and ACP_syn_III_C (PF08541).
Reference annotations identify EC 2.3.1.180 beta-ketoacyl-[acyl-carrier-protein] synthase III activity and homodimerization.

entities.name: FabH initiation reaction
observations: This is the first condensation step of bacterial fatty-acid biosynthesis; the enzyme transfers a two-carbon unit from malonyl-ACP to an acetyl acceptor with decarboxylation.

entities.name: Bacterial fatty acid biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme functions in lipid metabolism and initiates the fatty-acid biosynthetic pathway.
Substrate specificity can influence branched-chain versus straight-chain fatty-acid production.
